intro: FunPlay Systems designs and builds outdoor playground equipment for schools, housing societies, parks and resorts in Chennai. Everything is made at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, where we have been manufacturing play equipment since 2002. We send the finished equipment to Chennai by road and install it on site with our own team or a dealer near you.

Most Chennai enquiries we get fall into three groups. Builders need a play area for a new apartment project, schools need equipment that takes heavy daily use, and public parks stay busy from early morning to late evening. We help with all three, from picking the equipment to planning the layout and the safe play area around it.

sections.h: Choosing playground equipment for Chennai's weather
sections.html:
Chennai is hot and humid for most of the year, and sites near the coast get salt in the air. That combination is hard on bare metal. Galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic parts hold up far better, because plastic does not rust and the zinc coating protects the steel. If your slides or decks face the afternoon sun, plan some shade over them so the surfaces stay comfortable to touch.

The northeast monsoon, from October to December, brings most of the city's rain, and water collects quickly on flat ground. We suggest a slightly raised, well-drained base with rubber flooring or another impact-absorbing surface under the equipment. We supply rubber flooring along with the play equipment if you need it.

• Builders and housing societies along OMR, ECR, GST Road and in the western suburbs who need a play area ready before handover.
  • CBSE, ICSE and state board schools that want equipment for several age groups on one ground.
  • Municipal and corporate parks, including open-air gyms for adults and senior citizens.
  • Resorts, clubs and hotels, especially along the East Coast Road, that want a feature piece for families.

Each of these buyers has different needs. A builder wants a compact layout that looks good in brochures, a school wants pieces for several age groups, and a park needs equipment that can take crowds every evening.

1. Share the size of your site, the age group of the children and a few photos. We suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.
  2. Once you approve the layout and the quote, we manufacture the equipment at our Vasai factory.
  3. We pack it and dispatch it to Chennai by road.
  4. Our installation team or a local dealer installs it, using the self-standing or grouting method that suits your ground.

Through each step you deal with one contact person at FunPlay, who keeps you updated on manufacturing and dispatch.

For apartment play areas, a CoreCraft multi play system packs slides, climbers and decks into a compact footprint. Schools often choose a Funplay Originals design such as Ulta Ghar or Card Pyramid, which are built for groups of children to play together. Larger sites can look at the NexLev series. For adults, see our outdoor gym equipment in Chennai. If you are not sure where to start, send us photos of the site and we will shortlist three or four options that fit your space and budget.

facts.label: Installation
facts.value: By our installation team or a local dealer

faq.q: Do you deliver and install playground equipment in Chennai?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture the equipment at our factory in Vasai, send it to Chennai by road and install it through our own team or a local dealer.

faq.q: Which materials last longest in Chennai's humid, coastal weather?
faq.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic hold up best because they do not rust. For sites close to the sea, rinse the equipment from time to time and follow the maintenance steps we share at handover.

faq.q: What warranty do you give on playground equipment?
faq.a: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions.

faq.q: Can you plan a playground for a small society or school ground?
faq.a: Yes. Send us the length and width of the space and the age group of the children. We will suggest equipment that fits and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.
